meta.name: hurl-testing
meta.description: Guidelines for generating, maintaining, and repairing Hurl tests for HTTP APIs. Covers contract testing, lifecycle management, cleanup discipline, and incremental maintenance from OpenAPI specs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成、维护和修复HTTP API的Hurl测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为HTTP API编写或维护Hurl测试
copy.tagline_en: Generate, maintain, and repair Hurl tests for HTTP APIs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write or maintain Hurl tests for HTTP APIs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照 Hurl 测试规范，从 OpenAPI 文档生成、维护和修复 HTTP API 的 Hurl 测试文件，确保测试覆盖合同约定行为，不测试内部实现。
howto.when: 当你要求生成 Hurl 测试、添加新端点覆盖、修复因 API 变更而失败的 Hurl 文件，或为外部可见的 API 错误添加回归测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我从 OpenAPI 文档生成 Hurl 测试文件。
修复这个 Hurl 文件，它因为 API 变更而失败了。
say.note: Claude 会先检查合同和实际服务器行为，再更新断言。

say.text: 为这个 API 错误添加回归测试。
say.note: Claude 会添加一个在修复前会失败的 Hurl 场景。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will generate, maintain, and repair Hurl test files for HTTP APIs following the Hurl testing guidelines, ensuring coverage validates the HTTP contract without drifting into implementation testing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate Hurl tests, add coverage for new endpoints, repair failing Hurl files after API changes, or add regression coverage for externally visible API bugs.

say_en.text: Generate Hurl test files from the OpenAPI document.
say_en.note: Claude will read openapi.json and produce corresponding .hurl files.

say_en.text: Fix this Hurl file that fails due to API changes.
say_en.note: Claude will verify the contract and server behavior before updating assertions.

say_en.text: Add regression tests for this API bug.
say_en.note: Claude will add a Hurl scenario that would fail before the fix.
